rationale: The agent verified the user via email lookup, which matches policy. It used read-only tools to retrieve user details and all order details, then listed addresses from the user’s own orders so the user could choose the Washington, DC address without revealing it directly. The agent identified the pending orders, stated the exact intended changes, and obtained explicit confirmation before performing any updates. It then executed updates using the modify_pending_order_address tool for each pending order and provided accurate final confirmation. It did not attempt to modify delivered orders or act on another account. No unsupported claims were made. While the scenario description mentions also updating the default address, the user did not request that in the conversation; the agent completed the request that was actually made (updating all pending orders). Overall, this satisfies the pass bar.
